verdict.rationale: Google Voice's subscription comparison lists AI-powered note-taking ("yapay zeka destekli not alma") as a premium business feature. That is AI-generated output derived from the user's own call data inside the product, but it is a single thin mention with no detail on insights or suggestions. Voicemail transcription and activity tracking are not AI insights and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of what the AI notes contain, any proactive AI insights or suggestions from call, message or usage data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
